name: needle3-compaction
description: Verbatim, deletion-based context compaction for LLM agents, driven by Cactus Needle 3 on CPU (no API key, on-device).

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && npm run typecheck:hooks && npm run typecheck:pi
scripts.download-weights: npm run build && node -e "(async()=>{const{downloadNeedleWeights}=await import('./dist/needle3.js');console.log('weights ready at '+(await downloadNeedleWeights()))})()"
